seo.title: About - NexusContent Example
seo.description: How NexusContent separates content from application code.

hero.heading: Separation, by design.
hero.intro: NexusContent keeps the boundary between content sources and content consumers clean.

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.content: Give frontend applications a single, predictable content interface regardless of where the content lives.

story.heading: Our story
story.content: NexusContent began with one question: why should a website be rebuilt every time a content source changes? The answer is a thin, framework-neutral layer that normalizes content once and lets applications stay focused on presentation.

values.heading: Principles
items: Editable content lives outside the app.
